'''Elloise Moru''' was the wife of [[Ren Moru]], living on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] enslaved Ren for his debt of 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and forced him to mine [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] for the next two years. During this time Elloise was trying to save enough money to pay off Ren's debt, but the interest rates kept going up; she eventually realized that the debt for merely an excuse to keep Ren and the others working for free forever. In [[3637 BBY]] Ren was saved by an individual working to bring down the [[Order of Revan]] and Elloise send a letter of thanks to her husband's rescuer. Though the Moru couple left their old home, Ren stayed on Rishi and began working for the person who granted him freedom.<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />
